We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically (i.e., reverse of forward) reproduces the reaction: cycloaddition forming a ring, forming C-C bond, breaking C-O bond, losing ketones and C-C triple bonds functional groups. The target molecule is given: COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O

We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional groups broken in forward reaction: carbon-oxygen bond broken (so C-O broken). functional groups formed in forward: ketones and C-C triple bonds are lost (so they are present in reactants but not in product). Actually forward reaction loses ketones and C-C triple bonds, meaning those groups are present in starting materials and disappear in product. So in forward, they are broken? The description: "As a result of these transformations, a 'ketones' and 'C-C triple bonds' functional groups are lost." So functional groups formed? Not formed, they are lost. So they are present in reactants, not in product. So in forward reaction, they are broken (i.e., functional groups broken). So functional_groups_broken: ['ketones', 'C-C triple bonds']? Also carbon-oxygen bond broken: that's a functional group? maybe 'carboxylic esters' broken? The target has an ester (COC(=O) ...). The forward reaction breaks a C-O bond, likely the ester bond. So functional_groups_broken includes 'carboxylic esters'? The forward reaction forms a cycloaddition product, forming new C-C bond. So bonds formed: C-C. Bonds broken: C-O. Also maybe C-C triple bond broken (i.e., alkyne). So we can search with criteria.

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with target SMILES and functional_groups_broken list.
